licensing.acknowledgements.fullTexts: The full licence texts ship with Cmdr in <notices>THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md</notices>.
licensing.about.noLicense: No licence – only personal use allowed
licensing.commercialReminder.askCommerci: If you’re using Cmdr at work, please get a Commercial licence to stay compliant.
licensing.commercialReminder.priceInfo: A commercial licence is $59, paid once, and supports continued development.
licensing.expiration.title: Your commercial licence has expired
licensing.expiration.info: Cmdr is now running in personal use mode. If you’re still using it for work, please renew your licence.
licensing.dialog.resetConfirm: This will deactivate your current licence on this device. You can reactivate anytime with a valid key.
licensing.dialog.enterPrompt: Paste your licence key from the email you received after purchase. Don’t have one yet? <getLicense>Get a licence</getLicense>.
licensing.dialog.activatedToast: Licence activated. Thanks for your support! ❤️
licensing.dialog.networkFallbackError: Couldn’t verify your licence with the server. Please try again later.
licensing.dialog.expiredOnHelp: You can renew your subscription or purchase a new licence at getcmdr.com.
licensing.dialog.serverInvalidError: We know this key but when we checked it with our payment provider, it didn’t recognise it. This can happen if the purchase was refunded or not cleared.
licensing.error.badSignature: This licence key failed our signature verification, meaning that it doesn’t look like a valid key.
licensing.error.badFormat: Our licence key format is different from this.
licensing.error.badFormatHint: Licence keys are either a short code (CMDR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) or a longer cryptographic key from your purchase email.
licensing.error.shortCodeNotFound: This licence looks good, but we looked hard and couldn’t find it in our database.
licensing.error.network: Ouch, we couldn’t reach the licence server this time.
licensing.error.server: Hmm, the licence server responded with something weird. We’re sorry about that.
